name: Corporate Action Date SD 5
definition: Provides additional information regarding corporate action date details.

PlaceAndName.name: Place And Name
PlaceAndName.definition: xPath to the element that is being extended.

DTCLastDayForEarlyRedemption.name: DTC Last Day For Early Redemption
DTCLastDayForEarlyRedemption.definition: Last day on which DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation) will accept instructions for CD early redemptions. This is specific to CDs when the registered holder is deceased.

DTCPositionCaptureDate.name: DTC Position Capture Date
DTCPositionCaptureDate.definition: Date when positions are captured and entitlements are calculated in the system at DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

NewYorkCutOffDate.name: New York Cut Off Date
NewYorkCutOffDate.definition: Last day to deposit securities at DTC and receive the entitlement for an event approaching record date. Issues that have a New York cut-off date have an out-of-town agent on DTC's records.

DTCExtendedCutOffDate.name: DTC Extended Cut Off Date
DTCExtendedCutOffDate.definition: Cutoff date for DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation) deposit and withdrawal activity. Certain events require an earlier cutoff date. This is typically used on event securities requiring the submission of bearer coupons. Those events usually stop deposit and withdrawal activity one month prior to the declared record date.

EffectiveDateByExchange.name: Effective Date By Exchange
EffectiveDateByExchange.definition: Effective date as declared by the primary exchange that generally coincides with cessation of trading in the old security and commencement of trading in the new security.

DateDeclaredWorthless.name: Date Declared Worthless
DateDeclaredWorthless.definition: Date that DTC received formal notification from the agent/issuer stating that the securities are null and void.

DeleteWorthlessSecurityDate.name: Delete Worthless Security Date
DeleteWorthlessSecurityDate.definition: Date when DTC participant positions will be deleted. Typically used for expired rights and warrants.

DTCExitDate.name: DTC Exit Date
DTCExitDate.definition: Date on which securities will be exited to DTC participants from DTC (The Depository Trust Corporation).

SubscriptionBeginDate.name: Subscription Begin Date
SubscriptionBeginDate.definition: Date on which a holder can begin to subscribe for new/additional shares.
